Market today: A cautious mood, driven by volatile 10-year Treasury yields hitting 5% and then reversing. Chip stocks, once an AI darling, are now seen as a "pain trade," adding pressure to your concentrated tech book.

Your holdings: SOXL (-60.26%) and SPAL (-33.64%) are major concerns due to leveraged decay and deep losses; their default stops need immediate review. SMH (-14.91%) and QQQ (-0.77%) are also flagged for trimming. Remember, margin amplifies these drops.

Watch: Keep a close eye on the 10-year Treasury yield and evolving sentiment around the chip sector.

Bottom line: Prioritize managing your highly leveraged, underperforming positions and be wary of the shifting chip market.
plays: Adjust SOXL stop from 200; current price 101.13 means your stop is too high, risking further losses on this leveraged decay play.
Review SPAL stop at 21.38; leveraged ETFs decay and hurt extra on margin, especially with a -33.64% loss.
Consider a speculative long on SOXS (inverse chips) at 50.55-50.50 with a stop at 50.07, as chip sentiment sours.
